Settings.ApiKeyDescription: Optional bearer token used when calling the server.
Settings.ValidateToFetchModels: Click Validate after saving the server settings to fetch available models.
Settings.StreamResponsesDescription: Render prompt-action output token-by-token as the server generates it (works with Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, etc.), instead of waiting for the full reply.
Settings.ThinkingModeDescription: Chat Completions only. Controls whether reasoning models think before answering. Provider default sends no thinking control; Off disables it (DeepInfra: reasoning_effort none); On enables it. Think blocks are always removed from the output.
Settings.CouldNotConnect: Could not connect to the server.
Settings.ProfilesDescription: Extra OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Each profile appears as its own transcription engine and LLM provider you can select in dictation and prompts. The default endpoint above is unaffected.
Settings.ProfileApiKeyDescription: A stored key is kept unless you edit this field. Clearing the field removes the stored key.
Settings.ProfileTranscriptionModelDescri: Optional default; any fetched model can be chosen per workflow.
Settings.ProfileLlmModelDescription: Optional default; prompts can use any fetched model.
Manifest.Name: OpenAI Compatible
Manifest.Description: Connect to any OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, etc.)
Settings.LlmRequestTimeoutHelp: How long to wait for each LLM response. Enter a whole number from {0} to {1}. Default: {2} seconds.
Settings.LlmRequestTimeoutInvalid: Enter a whole number between {0} and {1} seconds.
Settings.LlmRequestTimedOut: The language model request timed out.
Settings.TextApiDescription: Chat Completions works with most servers; Responses is for servers that implement OpenAI's newer API.
Settings.ReasoningEffortDescription: Responses API only. An explicit effort omits temperature, which reasoning models may reject.
Settings.TemperatureModeDescription: Provider default sends no temperature; custom sends the value below.
Settings.TemperatureValueDescription: From 0 to 2. Lower values give more consistent results. Used only with the custom temperature mode.
Settings.TemperatureInvalid: Enter a temperature from 0 to 2 using a decimal point.
Settings.ApiVersionDescription: Leave empty unless your server requires a version. Azure deployment-scoped endpoints need a dated version such as 2025-03-01-preview.
Settings.BatchEndpointDescription: Standard uses /v1/audio/transcriptions. Deployment-scoped uses /deployments/{model}/audio/transcriptions and needs a dated API version.
Settings.ApiVersionRequired: Deployment-scoped transcription requires a dated API version, such as 2025-03-01-preview.
Settings.TranscriptionModeDescription: Auto uses realtime for gpt-live-transcribe and gpt-realtime-whisper models and batch for everything else. Realtime forces the /v1/realtime WebSocket for custom deployment aliases; batch always uploads the recording.
Settings.RealtimeProtocolDescription: Auto recognises the Realtime Whisper family and treats other models as Live Transcribe. Choose explicitly for custom aliases.
Settings.RealtimeNoTranslation: Realtime transcription does not support translation. Use batch mode.
